requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area. The 60-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified regulatory gross-area threshold was provided. Energy class and public transport proximity are outside the reference columns and are handled elsewhere. Turin is a city name, not a cadastral code, so comune_code is not set.

The user prefers an energy class C or better, so the filter includes all classes from C upward (A1-A4, B, C). Area (850 sqm), capacity (60 people) and proximity to public transport are not energy requirements and are excluded from this output.
User explicitly wants a location near public transport. Value set to the 75th percentile (70.93), rounded to 71.
A university student residence inherently requires nearby education services (universities/schools). Value set to the 75th percentile (75.14), rounded to 75.

output.explanation: Filters office-type properties (property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area >= 850, within 3.0 km of (45.0677551, 7.6824892), energy_class A1–A4/B/C, mobility >= 71 and education >= 75. Results are ordered by haversine distance to the search point, nearest first. No LIMIT, and no comune_code predicate is used.
